Copy of Registration Certificate/Experience Certificate/Performance Certificate/ Trade Licence etc. to be attached. 5.2 Bidder should have completed similar works to State/Central Government Depart ments/PSU Organizations/Leading Organizations/Warehouses/Container Yards/Private limited organizations in the last 3 years starting from 01.04.2023. Photocopies of Pur chase Order/Work Order/Completion certificate shall be submitted as documentary p roof. 5.3 The Average Turnover of the tenderer shall be minimum Rs.10 Lakhs during the l ast three financial years i.e., 2022-23, 2023-24 and 2024-25. mentioned criteria. The price bid submitted / opened will be not considered in case t he contractor fail to meet / submit any of the above / statutory requirements of the O rganization that are mentioned in the Tender Document. 5.6 Pre-qualification of the bidder shall not imply final acceptance of the offer. The bi ds may be rejected at any stage during the techno commercial evaluation or during t he price evaluation.
